description:
Project Overview:

Team ETHNOVA is building the AstroPulse Dashboard, a Progressive Web App (PWA) running 100% offline on a tablet to monitor astronaut vitals, radiation exposure, and mental readiness. We already have a 3-page layout blueprint and our core Python health algorithm ready.

Who We Are Looking For:We are a student-led team and are looking for enthusiastic peers  to collaborate with us over the next 8 weeks. We need:

1.1 UI/UX Designer (Figma / Sci-Fi Dark Mode theme)

2.1 Frontend Developer (To build the offline PWA framework)

Note: As this is a student-led initiative, we are prioritizing peer-to-peer collaboration!
